Lightning-fork splitting the sky starboard, purple-white flash catching her face, thunder rolling through the hull beneath her boots.
Enemy broadside blooming across the gap, cannonballs shrieking past the rigging, smoke swallowing the middle distance behind her.
Grappling hooks biting the gunwale rail, chains snapping taut, enemy boarders crouching at the gap preparing to leap.
Damaged portside engine erupting in amber sparks, oily smoke peeling back into the slipstream, heat washing across the deck.
Rival airship's envelope rupturing above, burning gas venting in a roaring orange column as it begins its death-spiral.
Vortex shear heeling the dirigible hard to starboard, every rope strumming taut, loose gear sliding fast across the tilted deck.
Signal-flare bursting violet directly overhead, hard purple light washing the entire deck, acrid smoke drifting through the rigging.
Enemy corvette surfacing from cloud cover below, all gun-ports opening simultaneously, muzzle-flash rippling down its flank.
Mid-air collision narrowly avoided, enemy rigging scraping the gunwale, splinters flying, the hulls grinding for one brutal second.
Forward mast cracking under cannon-strike, the spar swinging down on its shrouds, ropes snapping across the open deck.
Ammunition locker eruption amidships, the concussive bloom lifting deck-planks, orange fireball rolling upward past the envelope.
Three enemy fighters diving from directly above, their exhaust trails crisscrossing the sky like white slashes overhead.
Chainshot tearing through the rigging above her, cables unraveling in slow catastrophic sequence, blocks raining onto the deck.
Hail of enemy musket-fire pocking the gunwale, splinters kicking into the air in a continuous rattling storm around her.
Sister-ship colliding with a drifting derelict ahead, debris field expanding outward, tumbling wreckage crossing their own flight path.
Gas-cell puncture hissing above, the envelope visibly deflating on the port side, the whole airship beginning a slow list.
A burning enemy vessel drifting broadside-on into their path, heat radiating, its hull glowing as it closes the gap.
Depth-charge burst below the keel, a column of compressed air and smoke hammering upward, rattling every timber in the hull.
Enemy ram-ship accelerating head-on through the cloud bank, its reinforced prow aimed directly at the envelope above her head.
Double lightning-strike hitting both masts simultaneously, electricity crawling blue-white down every metal fitting on the deck around her.
Rigging fire racing up the starboard shrouds, flame driven horizontal by the wind, embers showering the open deck.
Canister-shot burst just off the bow, the sky ahead suddenly filled with a spreading black cone of spinning fragments.
Sudden pressure-drop plunging the airship into violent downdraft, the deck dropping away fast, everything not lashed rising into the air.
Burning signal-rocket skipping across the deck planks, trailing sparks and white smoke before vanishing over the leeward rail.
Enemy ironclad rising through the cloud layer directly beneath, gun-turrets rotating upward, muzzles already tracking toward the hull above.
